text:
maria: quick heads-up — starting merge of customer Ceres LoRA into pegasus-2x now. Need a fast smoke pack (int8 + int4) and tokenizer/stop-token sanity checks before we hand off to CS.

sam: noted. do we already handle their 4 extra special tokens? saw weird token ids in their upgrade diff.

maria: yes — we remapped them in the adapter metadata, but one of the long-form prompts truncates earlier than expected (looks like off-by-one when merging tokenizer configs).

eli: can you paste the quick eval numbers you ran locally?

maria: pasted below (quickpack run on local dev machine, no KV cache):

```
run_id: ceres-smoke-2026-03-21
model: pegasus-2x + ceres-lora
settings: int8, seq_len=512, batch=8
metrics: {
  rouge_l: 0.423,
  ppl: 12.6,
  answer_exact_match: 0.78
}
notes: int4 early test: rouge_l ~0.401, some stop-token droppings on long outputs
```

ci-bot: created smoke run https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/654321 (artifacts + logs).

zoe: int4 stop-token issue rings a bell — we had a similar symptom when KV-cache offsets weren't shifted after tokenizer remap. Might be mismatch between adapter KV ordering and serving runtime fallback path.

sam: to reproduce locally, run without KV cache and with the customer's token map applied:

```
python -m rw_infer.eval_smoke \
  --model pegasus-2x \
  --adapter ceres-lora \
  --token-map=customers/ceres/token_map.json \
  --quant int4 \
  --seq 512 \
  --no-kv-cache \
  --prompt-file tests/ceres/long_prompts.jsonl
```

maria: running that now on dev GPU, will post logs. If it reproduces, next step is a tiny patch in serving runtime to realign KV offsets for remapped tokens, or we force the adapter to use host tokenizer ids.

eli: allocating a slot on ded-pegasus-01 to do int4 full smoke (will take ~25min). If that passes, I can push a canary to Dedicated (customer-staging) with auto-fallback to hosted-pegasus-small.

maria: sounds good. CS wants a short report for the customer: action plan + ETA. If ded smoke passes, can we have a shortnotes doc and a small eval deck?

sam: I can draft the shortnotes. ETA: canary by EOD if ded smoke looks clean.

zoe: adding a quick checklist here for the handoff:
- reproduce stop-token on minimal prompt (done? in progress)
- run int8 + int4 full smoke on ded cluster
- run tokenizer roundtrip tests (encode->decode->encode) against cust token_map
- run small perf baseline to check latency delta (batch sizes 1/8/64)
- create canary route with fallback policy and monitor alerts

maria: perfect. I'll attach the prompts and the customer's sample set to the CI run. ping me @sam @eli when you have results. :eyes:

ci-bot: artifact upload complete (logs.tar.gz, eval_summary.json) https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/654321/logs.tar.gz

eli: finished ded run — int4 reproduces stop-token on 2/30 prompts. attaching excerpt: "...generated text abruptly ends at token id 5021 after remap". Looks like a boundary case.

maria: thanks — we'll try forcing host-token-ids for adapter merges as a mitigation. If that fixes it, we can release a patch and re-run the smokepack.

sam: thumbs up. I’ll start the shortnotes and include the mitigation steps.

maria: closing loop here later today with final verdict. :thumbsup:
